record: roadmap D: the size of a correlated oscillator residual in the four-outcome servo likelihood
status: DRAFT (D1): prepared for review, not frozen. No correlated design-point check, pilot or outcome run may execute against a draft.
claim: C14 (pilot). D revises its appendix scope only; D gates no freeze.

model.phase: point-sampled Gaussian AR(1): x_n = rho x_{n-1} + sqrt(1-rho^2) sigma xi_n, xi ~ N(0,1)
model.latent_state: unwrapped x on a truncated real grid; the wrapped phase is not a Markov lumping of it, since x and x + 2 pi have next-step means differing by 2 pi rho
model.emission: P(B1,B2 | x, eps) = (1 + B1 C1 cos(x+ph1))(1 + B2 C2 cos(x+eps+ph2))/4, C1 = C2 = 0.9
model.signal: white Gaussian modulation of variance 0.09 for the variance channel; oscillator parameters identical under both hypotheses
model.offsets: frozen at the maximisers found at rho = 0 under the matched marginal and reused at every rho; the slope channel searches the full 13x13 grid, the variance channel grid[::3]
model.records: paired across rho by common random numbers

K5.marginal_match: exp(-sigma^2/2) = I1(kappa)/I0(kappa), the von Mises first circular moment

K10.marginal_match: exp(-sigma^2/2) = I1(kappa)/I0(kappa), the von Mises first circular moment

estimands.slope: C_eff,slope = sqrt(J), J the Fisher-information rate, estimated by the conditional-information average along the filtered history
estimands.variance: C_eff,var solves I_ext_exact(C_eff, 0.3) = D, D the KL rate from two filters
estimands.score: the total score S_N is retained for derivative checks only; S_N^2/N is not an estimator here, its per-record variance does not shrink with N

ND1a_fisher_nesting.requirement: the conditional-information estimator equals the single-shot Fisher information under the same discretised marginal

ND1b_kl_nesting.requirement: per-shot increments equal the i.i.d. log-likelihood ratios, and the sampled mean agrees with the analytic i.i.d. KL within sampling uncertainty

ND2_grid.requirement: J is stable in grid spacing M and tail range L

ND3_brute_force.requirement: on short records the filter's likelihood equals an explicit sum over latent grid paths

ND4_score.requirement: the analytic tangent matches central differences, and the normalisation without the quotient-rule term is rejected

ND5_simulator.requirement: stationary variance, lag-one correlation and first circular moment reproduce their targets

ND6_marginal.requirement: the von Mises baseline at rho = 0 against the Gaussian baseline at rho = 0, reported separately as the marginal effect, never as correlation

ND7_burn_in.requirement: stability in the discarded burn-in length for the filter, the tangent and both KL filters

numerical_checks.failure: a failed check blocks the outcome; these criteria are frozen before the checks run

pilot.seeds: design_points[*].seeds.pilot, disjoint from checks and evaluation
pilot.recorded: per-record wall seconds and shots, the across-record variance of J_hat, and t_step
pilot.not_recorded: no per-record J, no mean of them, no ratio to J(0)
pilot.purpose: variance and cost only; it fixes N and R through the sizing rule below

sizing_rule.rule: R and N are chosen so that the half-width of the absolute interval, after the numerical allowance, is at most kappa_D x tolerance
sizing_rule.no_topups: N and R are fixed before the outcome run; no extension or replacement record may follow from a measured value

uncertainty.interval: t(0.975, R-1) on J_hat(rho) across paired records
uncertainty.denominator: J(0) computed directly and deterministically under the matched marginal, not a second Monte-Carlo estimate
uncertainty.transform: g(J) = sqrt(J/J(0)) - 1, monotone, endpoint to endpoint
uncertainty.absolute_image: a signed interval containing 0 maps to [0, max(|lo|,|hi|)]; otherwise [min(|lo|,|hi|), max(|lo|,|hi|)]
uncertainty.numerical_allowance: the ND2 and ND7 residuals and the numerical uncertainty of J(0), converted to ratio units, widen the absolute interval before it is compared with the tolerance; the verdict must survive that widening. Passing a convergence threshold does not settle a result near the tolerance.
uncertainty.nonpositive: if the lower bound of J_hat(rho) is <= 0 the ratio is not formed: UNRESOLVED

rule: BELOW if the widened absolute interval lies wholly below the tolerance
ABOVE if it lies wholly above
UNRESOLVED if it straddles the tolerance, touches it, or the numerical allowance cannot be met
classification.variance_channel: reported separately with its own interval
classification.channel_agreement: a further statistic, never the change-from-independence criterion

budget.cost_note: R N M^2 is 2.097152e11 matrix terms for one propagation per shot at R = 16, N = 2e5, M = 256; the score adds a propagation and the KL channel runs two filters. D1 measures the real cost before any sizing is applied.

refusals: a draft status or a digest mismatch
an existing output for the phase
